en.title: Make the whole environment easier to use
en.subtitle: Reduce what a person must find, remember, interpret and manage
en.focusTitle: Model assistance: a major part the model can improve
en.focus: Filter information, assess options, carry out the work and preserve context.
en.outcome: The whole activity becomes easier to understand and continue
en.detail: Results and meaningful choices are clear; further detail is available when needed.
en.return: Use experience to improve how the environment is designed
en.description: The overall goal is to reduce cognitive complexity in the person's environment. Information and interfaces, operations and continuity, and model assistance impose connected requirements. Model assistance is a major directly improvable part. Visuals, clarity and intuition guide changes, whose results are judged across the whole activity and feed back into environment design.

zh-CN.title: 让整个环境更容易理解与使用
zh-CN.subtitle: 减少人需要寻找、记忆、解释和管理的内容
zh-CN.focusTitle: 模型辅助：模型能直接改进的重要部分
zh-CN.focus: 筛选信息、评估选项、承担实现、保住上下文，让帮助本身更简单。
zh-CN.outcome: 整项活动更容易看懂、开展和接续
zh-CN.detail: 结果与重要选择清楚可见，所需细节在用到时展开。
zh-CN.return: 从实际使用返回，改进设计环境的方法
zh-CN.description: 总目标是减少用户环境的认知复杂性。信息与界面、操作与接续、模型辅助共同形成相连的要求。模型辅助是其中模型能直接改进的重要部分。图大于文字、清晰大于复杂、直观大于形式指导改变，再从整项活动的使用结果改进设计环境的方法。
